title: Medication Guide approval, supply to authorized dispensers, and the registration carve-out
subtopic: How Medication Guides reach the authorized dispenser
rule_summary: Under 21 CFR 208.24(a) the manufacturer of a drug product for which a Medication Guide is required under Part 208 shall obtain FDA approval of the Medication Guide before the Medication Guide may be distributed. Under 208.24(b) each manufacturer who ships a container of such a drug product is responsible for ensuring that Medication Guides are available for distribution to patients, either by providing Medication Guides, or by providing the means to produce Medication Guides, in sufficient numbers to distributors, packers, or authorized dispensers to permit the authorized dispenser to provide a Medication Guide to each patient receiving a prescription for the drug product. Under 208.24(c) each distributor or packer that receives Medication Guides, or the means to produce them, from a manufacturer under 208.24(b) shall provide those Medication Guides, or the means to produce them, to each authorized dispenser to whom it ships a container of the drug product. Under 208.24(f) an authorized dispenser or wholesaler is not subject to section 510 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, which requires the registration of producers of drugs and the listing of drugs in commercial distribution, solely because of an act performed by the authorized dispenser or wholesaler under Part 208.
exam_relevance: Separates the manufacturer's approval and supply duties and the distributor's or packer's pass-through duty from the authorized dispenser's duty to provide the Guide, and shows that acting under Part 208 does not by itself make a dispenser subject to drug establishment registration.

authority.name: Distributing and dispensing a Medication Guide

common_confusions: Placing the duty to obtain FDA approval of a Medication Guide on the dispenser; 21 CFR 208.24(a) places it on the manufacturer.
Reading the manufacturer's duty as satisfied only by shipping printed Guides; 21 CFR 208.24(b) allows the manufacturer to provide either the Guides or the means to produce them.

Assuming an authorized dispenser that produces Guides from means supplied to it must register under section 510; 21 CFR 208.24(f) says an act performed under Part 208 does not by itself make the dispenser subject to section 510.
verification_notes: Read the current text of 21 CFR 208.24 on eCFR on 2026-09-14.
